session_read: Broad AI-capex sympathy rally Friday (SMH +2.61%), driven by NVIDIA's $12.9bn Hugging Face deal and independently-corroborated memory supply tightness -- not fresh fundamentals. Sentiment 67/greed via low-VIX-at-highs, echoing the setup ahead of the 2026-08-18 rout. Book unchanged in composition since this morning's run; strategist leans toward trimming strength into CPI (09-11) and FOMC (09-16).
